research_note: Curated from primary pages, abstracts and project descriptions. Books, recordings and code were not fully read, watched or executed.

resources.title: Rust as the Foundation for Future Unmanned Systems
resources.why: Provides an earlier account of MOSAIC’s architecture, Rust migration and legacy integration.
resources.caveat: Official programme checked; different speakers from EuroRust, and no delivery or recording is verified.

resources.title: Comparison of Middlewares in Edge-to-Edge and Edge-to-Cloud Communication for Distributed ROS2 Systems
resources.why: Compares communication tradeoffs under different networks for distributed robotic systems.
resources.caveat: Abstract and publication record checked; experiments are specific to the paper’s ROS 2 setup, not MOSAIC.

resources.title: What is Zenoh?
resources.why: Introduces another approach to moving data across distributed and constrained systems.
resources.caveat: Comparison material; the EuroRust abstract does not say that MOSAIC uses Zenoh.

resources.title: Rust bindings for ROS 2
resources.why: Shows how Rust can participate in an existing robotics middleware ecosystem.
resources.caveat: Independent alternative; no claim that the speakers use this project.

resources.title: Bridging robotics and systems programming: why Copper is a game changer
resources.why: Offers a future comparison of Rust runtime design for robot integration and concurrent execution.
resources.caveat: Announced session on November 2, 2026; the title is the organizer’s wording, not a repository endorsement.
